handoff.plan:
starter_template:
  mode: none
  rationale: No catalog template matches a four-corner match-the-item picker with per-target
    idle/wrong/correct sprite states; build from scratch reusing the Mamamy Tower brand kit,
    record-start and result patterns.
game_type:
  camera_feed: visible
  ar_tracking: none
  core_loop_seconds: 3
  total_duration_seconds: 20
camera_feed_constraints:
  tracking_type: none
  tracking_range: not applicable - camera feed is only the backdrop
  user_image_visible: true
  composition: none
mechanic:
  class: other
  description: "Four babies sit in the four corners, each in need: top-left girl needs bottle washing
    liquid, top-right muddy boy needs bath foam, bottom-left dirty-diaper boy needs wet wipes,
    bottom-right paint-stained girl needs laundry liquid. The four products appear one at a time
    (shuffled) in the centre. The player taps the baby (or drags the product onto the baby). Right
    baby: the product flies to it and the baby switches to its happy 'correct' sprite for good.
    Wrong baby: that baby switches to its crying 'wrong' sprite and shakes for ~1s, then returns to
    idle, and the product stays for another try. Babies not yet served stay 'idle'. After all four:
    MEGA MAMAMY 19 logo + confetti + completion time + PLAY AGAIN."
  parameters:
    products: 4
    babies: 4
    baby_states:
      - idle
      - wrong
      - correct
    wrong_state_sec: 1
screens:
  - name: Intro
    role: intro
    initial_visible: true
    layout:
      - id: intro_logo
        element: MEGA MAMAMY 19 logo
        position: center, y=+80
        size: 500x154
        kind: decoration
      - id: intro_hint
        element: brand text image
        position: center, y=-20
        content: Món này dành cho bé nào?
        kind: hud
      - id: intro_button
        element: brand pink pill with RECORD TO PLAY
        position: center, y=-110
        size: 330x58
        kind: button
        interactive: true
  - name: Gameplay
    role: gameplay
    initial_visible: true
    layout:
      - id: baby_tl
        element: girl with bottle (idle/wrong/correct sprites)
        position: top-left (-160,+438)
        size: 285x315
        kind: playable
        interactive: true
      - id: baby_tr
        element: muddy boy (idle/wrong/correct sprites)
        position: top-right (+206,+430)
        size: 242x309
        kind: playable
        interactive: true
      - id: baby_bl
        element: dirty-diaper boy (idle/wrong/correct sprites)
        position: bottom-left (-187,-263)
        size: 262x279
        kind: playable
        interactive: true
      - id: baby_br
        element: paint-stained girl (idle/wrong/correct sprites)
        position: bottom-right (+211,-252)
        size: 299x324
        kind: playable
        interactive: true
      - id: product
        element: current Mamamy product
        position: center (0,+70), fit 300x280
        kind: playable
        interactive: true
      - id: popup
        element: ĐÚNG RỒI! / CHƯA ĐÚNG! text image
        position: near the chosen baby
        kind: hud
  - name: Result
    role: result
    initial_visible: false
    layout:
      - id: result_dim
        element: black dim
        position: full screen
        kind: result
        translucent: true
        opacity: 0.35
      - id: result_logo
        element: MEGA MAMAMY 19 logo
        position: center, y=+250
        kind: result
      - id: result_title
        element: BÉ NÀO CŨNG VUI!
        position: center, y=+130
        kind: result
      - id: result_card
        element: "white card: Bạn hoàn thành trong / N / giây"
        position: center, y=-20
        size: 300x200
        kind: result
      - id: retry_button
        element: pink pill PLAY AGAIN
        position: center, y=-190
        size: 266x60
        kind: button
        interactive: true
      - id: confetti
        element: Sparkly Confetti library effect
        position: full screen
        kind: decoration
interactions:
  - kind: record_start_reset
    trigger: APJS.EventType.RecordStart
    response: Reset every baby to idle, shuffle products, show the first product, start the clock
    state_change: any -> PLAYING
    target:
      scope: none
      rationale: global lifecycle event
  - kind: screen_transition
    trigger: tap the RECORD TO PLAY button in INTRO
    response: Same as record start (lets the effect be tried without recording)
    state_change: INTRO -> PLAYING
    target:
      scope: screen_element
      screen_element_ids:
        - intro_button
    feedback:
      visual: intro hides, first product pops in
  - kind: gameplay_action
    trigger: tap a baby, or drag the product and release on a baby
    response: "Right baby: product flies in, baby -> correct sprite. Wrong baby: baby -> wrong sprite +
      shake 1s, product returns"
    state_change: PLAYING -> PLAYING, or RESULT after the 4th right answer
    target:
      scope: screen_element
      screen_element_ids:
        - baby_tl
        - baby_tr
        - baby_bl
        - baby_br
        - product
    feedback:
      visual: ĐÚNG RỒI! or CHƯA ĐÚNG! popup, baby sprite swap with pop/shake
  - kind: retry
    trigger: tap anywhere on RESULT after 1.3s
    response: Restart a new round
    state_change: RESULT -> PLAYING
    target:
      scope: screen_element
      screen_element_ids:
        - retry_button
    feedback:
      visual: result hides, babies back to idle
assets:
  - id: asset.babies
    role: targets
    description: Four babies x three states (idle, wrong = crying harder, correct = happy/clean) cropped
      from MMM SBD Effect 1 PNGs with a shared box per baby
    is_background: false
    count: 12
    animated: false
    coverage: partial
    interactive_role: addressable_part
    kind: visual
  - id: asset.products
    role: items
    description: "Four Mamamy products: Tropical wet wipes, bath foam, bottle washing liquid with
      brushes, 2-in-1 laundry pouch"
    is_background: false
    count: 4
    animated: false
    coverage: partial
    interactive_role: spawnable_pool
    kind: visual
  - id: asset.logo
    role: title
    description: MEGA MAMAMY 19 logo with shield, used on intro and result
    is_background: false
    count: 1
    animated: false
    coverage: partial
    interactive_role: decoration
    kind: visual
  - id: asset.text
    role: brand text
    description: SVN-Gotham brand-pink text images, CTA texts, digit images and pill buttons reused from
      the Mamamy Tower kit
    is_background: false
    count: 20
    animated: false
    coverage: partial
    interactive_role: decoration
    kind: visual
random_behaviors:
  - what: product order
    range: shuffle of the 4 products each round
    verify_strategy: log the order via get_script_logs
criteria:
  - category: layout
    check: Babies sit where the mockup puts them; product centred between them
  - category: state
    check: Tapping the right baby swaps it to its correct sprite and shows the next product
  - category: state
    check: Tapping a wrong baby shows its crying sprite then returns to idle; product stays
  - category: state
    check: After 4 right answers the result shows the logo, confetti and time
  - category: camera_feed
    check: Live camera feed visible behind the game
  - category: state
    check: Tapping the product itself or empty space does nothing; an already-happy baby never changes
      back
  - category: value
    check: Result time equals the seconds from first product to last right answer
scene_representation:
  planning_mode: explicit
  decision_summary: "Flat 2D screen-space game over the camera feed: Screen Images for
    babies/product/UI driven by one APJS script on a GameManager."
  space:
    kind: screen
    description: 720x1280 ScreenTransform space, origin at center
  content_form:
    kind: flat_2d
    description: PNG sprites on Screen Images
  requirements:
    - id: req.pick
      description: Tap/drag gives the product to a baby; right/wrong feedback via baby sprite states
      must: true
      layer_refs:
        - layer.game
      verification_refs:
        - ver.play
    - id: req.result
      description: Result after all 4 products with logo, confetti, time, PLAY AGAIN
      must: true
      layer_refs:
        - layer.ui
      verification_refs:
        - ver.play
    - id: req.camera
      description: Camera feed visible
      must: true
      layer_refs:
        - layer.camera
      verification_refs:
        - ver.play
  layers:
    - id: layer.game
      role: gameplay
      description: Babies and product
      space:
        kind: screen
        description: screen
      content_form:
        kind: flat_2d
        description: flat_2d
      requirement_refs:
        - req.pick
    - id: layer.ui
      role: overlays
      description: Intro, popup, result, confetti
      space:
        kind: screen
        description: screen
      content_form:
        kind: flat_2d
        description: flat_2d
      requirement_refs:
        - req.result
    - id: layer.camera
      role: backdrop
      description: Camera feed
      space:
        kind: screen
        description: screen
      content_form:
        kind: camera_feed
        description: camera_feed
      requirement_refs:
        - req.camera
  verification:
    - id: ver.play
      description: "interact_by_dsl: record, tap wrong then right babies, screenshot each state"
      requirement_refs:
        - req.pick
        - req.result
        - req.camera
      views_or_states:
        - intro
        - wrong
        - correct
        - result
      success_criteria: |-
        sprite states swap
        result shows
        camera feed visible behind babies
  fallbacks:
    unknown_requirement: adapt_and_verify
    unmet_must: stop_and_explain
mechanic_rationale: "The client mockups (MMM SBD Effect 1 1-7 + KHONG DUNG) already pin down the
  full loop: four fixed baby targets with idle/wrong/correct art, one product at a time in the
  centre, and a MEGA MAMAMY 19 finale, so no catalog mechanic is borrowed."
plan_type: game
